sentences.en: The text is deemed as fluent in the target language.

sentences.en: So may I win the victory and be deemed wise.

sentences.en: The conditions were deemed sufficiently unsafe to justify an evacuation.
sentences.zh: 鉴于条件足够不安全，因此进行了撤离。
